### Healthpeak Properties Announces Dates of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release, Conference Call, and Webcast


October 01, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/584270836/files/doc_news/Healthpeak-Properties-Announces-Dates-of-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-Conference-Call-and-Webcast-2026.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Healthpeak Properties, Inc. (NYSE: DOC), a leading owner, operator, and developer of real estate for healthcare discovery and delivery, is scheduled to report third quarter 2026 financial results after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Monday, November 2, 2026.


Healthpeak will host a conference call and webcast on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time to review its financial performance and operating results.


The conference call can be accessed in the following ways:


- Healthpeak’s website:[https://ir.healthpeak.com/news-events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.healthpeak.com%2Fnews-events%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54614609&newsitemid=20261001108489&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.healthpeak.com%2Fnews-events&index=1&md5=73d5fec3ae08b79432da7b72122a4361)
- Webcast:[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/917525646](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F917525646&esheet=54614609&newsitemid=20261001108489&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F917525646&index=2&md5=b91edf98833f3c541c10f4238ec2d8cf) . Joining via webcast is recommended for those who will not be asking questions.
- Telephone: The participant dial-in number is (833) 461-5787. The international dial-in is (585) 542-9983. The conference ID number is 917 525 646.


A webcast replay will be available on Healthpeak’s website through December 3, 2026.


**ABOUT HEALTHPEAK PROPERTIES**


Healthpeak Properties, Inc. is a fully integrated real estate investment trust (REIT) and S&P 500 company. Healthpeak owns, operates, and develops high-quality real estate focused on healthcare discovery and delivery. For more information regarding Healthpeak, visit[https://www.healthpeak.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.healthpeak.com%2F&esheet=54614609&newsitemid=20261001108489&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.healthpeak.com%2F&index=3&md5=cc6f33ea36e43a6273983625bc7f094d) .


Andrew Johns, CFA
